behavior: Exported module interface fingerprints cover function and generic signatures, contracts, declared effects and capabilities, nominal declarations, payloads, fields, and import routes while excluding function bodies and source spans.
Importer cache guards include the current dependency declaration spans and semantic binding table, so a comment shift that moves an imported declaration invalidates cached importer navigation data.
A cache hit rebuilds imported functions, nominal declarations, and dependency identities from the current linked closure while retaining the module's own cached elaboration.
Language still validates current function bodies against their actual semantic dependencies after the current program is assembled.
Cache schema /2 entries are rejected and relinked under /3; they are not interpreted under the new dependency contract.

resource_measurement.command: /usr/bin/time -f 'wall_seconds=%e user_seconds=%U system_seconds=%S max_rss_kb=%M' cargo test -p mncs-compiler --test module_imports --quiet

limitations: Compiler repository application-build integration and canonical VM parity against this new Language revision remain to be rerun after pinning the delivered Language main commit.
The resource measurement is for the cached Language module-import test suite; it is not a native application build performance claim.
